prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate exactly ONE high-fidelity Simplified Chinese EXISTING DooKnow LOCAL SETTINGS WINDOW component for design review. Draw only the complete real modal/drawer on a quiet neutral light-gray backdrop, naturally readable desktop scale; no browser/device chrome, no invented parent workspace or presentation captions. The supplied PILOT-WS-001 is STYLE ONLY: flat white/#f7f8fa, text #272b3a/#657084, #e6e9f1 thin lines, #4566c6 primary/#edf1ff selection, clear compact typography, aligned fields, small8px radii and restrained shadow. Do NOT copy PILOT owner rail/header/tree/search/create/empty note into this local component.
Content/role/control authority is the real source template, not generic API summaries. Selected component states below are source-derived isolated examples where the parent baseline does not capture this window; no runtime verification or business success is implied. Preserve title/icon/close, full field order, genuine labels/descriptions/conditional controls, body scroll and reachable fixed footer. This is authenticated OWNER management, not public guest.
Only one coherent selected state. No mixed preview/result/error/recovery/busy states unless specified; no additional nav, invented inputs/features, ToDoo tasks, AI/team/social/password gate. Backend requestId/version/hash/cursor/CSRF/nonce are NOT product inputs. Existing read-only backup/path/time identifiers may appear as source allows, with synthetic placeholders only. Secrets must be EMPTY or masked, never actual key/password contents. Native file-input buttons are allowed, but no OS/browser file-picker window. Do not convert source validation rules into extra fields or automatic disabled rules; actual template guards win.
SELECTED COMPONENT:
LOCAL RECOVERY-KEY PASSWORD MODAL, real width520px. Header key icon, title 下载恢复密钥, description 输入当前账户密码后下载私钥文件。请与备份分开保存，避免丢失后无法恢复。, existing close X. Source-derived nonbusy state, current password has synthetic MASKED characters “••••••••”, not a real secret; no prior attempt/error, no validation checkmark. Exactly one field 当前密码 with password masking and existing visibility eye icon. Footer 取消 enabled, primary download-icon 验证密码并下载密钥 enabled. No key text, key fingerprint, backup picker, passphrase/confirmation field, password strength or remember/revoke checkbox. The action checks password server-side and clears attempted password; do not show downloaded/success status or private-key content in this pre-submit state. Dirty close protects entered password on interaction, no discard confirmation open simultaneously. Keep complete natural-size modal, readable exact copy and reachable footer.
